title: Immunohistochemistry and _in situ_ hybridization protocols
protocol: Fix sections in 4% Para-PBS for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Wash sections with 1XPBS at 4°C for 5 minutes (repeat wash).
Dry slides around the area where you will write with Immedged pen and place them on upside-down 96 well plates.
Draw a boundary using Immedged pen or place gaskets around sections before starting incubations.
Incubate sections in blocking solution at 4°C for 30 minutes on a level surface in a humid chamber.
Rinse sections with PBS at 4°C for 3 x 5 minutes.
Incubate sections overnight at 4°C on a level surface in a humid chamber using primary antibody solution.
Wash in PBS at room temperature for 3 X 5 min.
Incubate secondary antibody in Solution in 1XPBS BSA @ 1.0% for 1 hour at room temperature on a level surface chamber (Secondary antibody 1:250 dilution).
Wash in 1XPBS for 5 min.
Mount slides using Gel/Mount aqueous mounting medium with anti-fading agents from Biomedia Corp.
Design Forward primer and Reverse primer; reverse primer has a T7 site inserted into the 5' end (TAATACGACTCACTATAGG).
Generate DNA template by PCR to produce approximately 300 bp product.
Dilute primers to 10 pmol/ul.
Take PCR product and add 150 ul of ETOH/salt mixture (300 ul 5 M NaCl + 20 ml 100% ETOH).
Mix well and place in -20°C freezer overnight.
Spin for 15 min at max speed (4°C) the next day.
Remove supernate by pipetting out.
Add 70% ETOH to pellets; spin for 15 min at max speed (4°C).
Remove supernate by pipetting out.
Resuspend PCR products in 50 μl of 1 X TE buffer.
Heat resuspended PCR products for 15 min at room temperature to ensure entire pellet is resuspended.
Prepare a solution of 4% Paraformaldehyde in 1X PBS, pH 7.4, and filter it.
Fix samples with the prepared solution for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash samples in 1X PBS for 1 minute at room temperature.
Wash samples in 0.1 M TEA, pH 8.0, for 1 minute at room temperature.
Mix 9 gms of TEA and 500 ml DEPC H2O, add 4 ml of 5M NaOH DEPC treated to make the solution for step 3.
Add 500 μl of 0.25% Acetic Anhydride to 200 mls of 0.1 M TEA right before using and incubate samples in this mixture for 15 minutes on a stir plate.
Wash samples twice in 2X SSC buffer, each wash lasting 2 minutes at room temperature.
Dehydrate samples:
a. Incubate in 30% ETOH for 2 minutes.
b. Incubate in 75% ETOH for 2 minutes.
c. Incubate in 100% ETOH for 2 minutes.
Air dry the slides on a drying rack and freeze them at -80°C or proceed to In Situ Day 1.
Make Hybridization Buffer: Mix 100 mls of Formamide, 24 mls of 5M NaCl (made with DEPC), 2 mls of 1M Tris HCl pH 7.4 (made with DEPC), and 4 mls of 50X Denhardts from Sigma.
Add 5 mls of tRNA at 10 mg/ml (from sigma) to the mixture.
Pipette out 4 mls into 15 ml falcon tubes for storage in freezer.
Boil salmon sperm DNA for 10 minutes before use.
Dissolve dextran sulfate in buffer to achieve an 80:20 ratio of buffer to dextran sulfate.
Add salmon sperm DNA to the buffer-dextran sulfate mixture to reach a final concentration of 0.1 mg/ml.
Add DTT to the mixture to reach a final concentration of 10 mM.
Heat S35 probe to 85°C for 5 minutes before adding it to the buffer.
Mix all reagents in the hybridization buffer and leave at 60-70°C to ensure that dextran fully dissolves.
Tilt cover slips at a 45-degree angle when applying them.
Prepare Mat Wet Fluid by mixing 10 ml of 20X SSC, 25 ml of formamide, and making up to 50 ml with DEPC H2O.
Put into a 37°C water bath for 2 hours.
Add 1 μl of DNAse I.
Return to the 37°C water bath for 15 minutes.
Add 45 μl of STE Buffer to the probe.
Spin columns at 1 minute to remove buffer.
Transfer the probe to a spin column.
Centrifuge for 4 minutes.
Count 1 μl in a scintillation counter.
Second Day In Situ:
Allow coverslips to float off in 2x SSC.
Transfer slides to holder in 2x SSC until all are finished.
Wash up and down several times in 2x SSC.
Transfer slides to 200 mL of RNAse Buffer.
Wash up and down several times.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Washes:
Wash in 2x SSC at room temperature (10 minutes).
Wash in 0.2x SSC + 5mM DTT at 60°C for 20 minutes.
Wash in 0.1x SSC + 5mM DTT at 60°C for 20 minutes.
Wash in 0.1x SSC at room temperature for 1 minute.
Rinse in MilliQ H2O.
Air dry on a drying rack and expose to film (notch in upper left hand corner).
